skills.content:
---
name: budget-subscription-hunter
description: >-
  Use when reviewing bank transactions to build a budget, find recurring or
  forgotten subscriptions, and prepare cancellation steps.
---
# Budget and subscription hunter

1. List the owner's linked accounts and pull the last 90 days of transactions from Finance (Plaid). Read-only; never move money.
2. Group recurring charges by merchant and amount pattern (weekly, monthly, annual). For each: merchant, amount, cadence, last charge date, account. Mark one-time purchases as one-time, not subscriptions.
3. Flag likely forgotten ones: no matching usage signs, price increases, duplicates, trials that converted.
4. Categorize all spending (housing, food, groceries, transport, subscriptions, shopping, fun, other) and compare to the owner's budget targets in memory.
5. Write results to the owner's budget Google Sheet: tabs Spending (by category and month), Subscriptions (with a Keep/Cancel column), Flags.
6. For each flagged subscription, look up where it is managed (App Store, Google Play, merchant site, card statement) and write plain cancellation steps. Never cancel, log in, or contact a merchant without explicit approval in chat.
7. Send a short summary: total spent vs budget, top 3 categories, new or changed recurring charges, and the money saved per month if flagged items are cancelled. Report real numbers only; if data is missing, say which account.

skills.content:
---
name: budget-hunter-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation of the Budget and Subscription Hunter bot with a
  new owner.
---
# Getting started

Say in one line: I watch your bank transactions, keep a budget sheet, and catch subscriptions you forgot about. I never move money or cancel anything without your OK.

Ask one at a time:
1. Connect Finance (Plaid) to link your bank and card accounts. Install or authenticate it if missing.
2. Connect Google Sheets. Use an existing budget sheet or should I create one?
3. Monthly take-home income and any budget targets by category (or let me suggest them from 90 days of spending).
4. What day and time for a weekly check-in (default Sunday 6 PM your time)?

Then: save the income, targets, and sheet link as memories; create the sheet if needed; create a weekly routine that runs the budget-subscription-hunter skill and stays quiet unless something changed or a summary is due; and run the first full pass now.

plugins.name: Finance
plugins.description: Link your bank, card, and investment accounts through Plaid so Grok can answer questions about balances, spending, subscriptions, and investments. You'll share contact details, account and balance info, transactions, credit and loans, and investments. Grok syncs and stores your linked account data so the connector can work, and Grok Bot's privacy mode still controls whether your conversations are stored or used for training. Access is read-only, xAI never sees or stores your bank login, and you can unlink accounts anytime from cursor.com.
